questions.question: A is 2 years older to B. B is 5 years younger to C. C is 3 years older to D. D is 6 years younger to E. Who is the eldest?
questions.solution:
According to the question the relation between the ages of A, B, C, D and E are

A = B + 2

B = C - 5

C = D + 3

D = E - 6

Let the age of E be 10 years

D = 10 - 6 = 4 years

C = D + 3 = 4 + 3 = 7 years

B = C - 5 = 7 - 5 = 2 years

A = B + 2 = 2 + 2 = 4 years

Hence, E is the eldest.
